Survey/research-programme paper: Table 1 p.896 gives Theen pop. 200 (Laos 1985), autonym /theen/, a.k.a. khaa saam liam; pp.897-899 say Theen was 'previously known only by virtue of a list of 40 words published by Ngô Đức Thịnh and Trương Văn Sinh (1973)', Souksavang Simana added 80 words in 1992 (unpublished), Proschan worked with three Theen speakers in Vientiane in Feb 1994, continued by Diffloth in 1995.
